title: Kiln publishing config (kiln.publish.json in the mod project), format 1
description: Where and how 'kiln publish' releases the mod. The file never holds a secret: the provider's token is read from the PC's credential store when a plan is applied. 'kiln publish --plan' reads this file, audits the packed zip and freezes both into a plan; a change of this file after planning needs a new plan. Unknown keys are refused, so a typo cannot silently change what is published.

provider.description: The provider. This Kiln publishes to GitHub releases.

tag.description: The release tag with {version} once: v{version}, or mods/my-mod/v{version} in a repository of several mods. {version} is the version in the mod's manifest.

commit.description: The commit the tag is created at: the full id, never a branch name. An existing tag is never moved.

prerelease.description: Mark the release as a prerelease.

notes.description: Path of the release notes (UTF-8, at most 1 MiB), relative to this file. They become the text of the release.

packageFiles.description: Files of the zip that need a declaration: shipped default configs and third-party DLLs. A declaration never allows what the artifact policy forbids (game data, cooked output, saves, keys, Kiln's or .NET's own DLLs).

path.description: Path inside the mod folder, e.g. config/defaults/my-mod.json or lib/Some.Library.dll.

purpose.description: default-config: a file under config/defaults/ (keys that name a password, token, secret, API key or credential must be empty). dependency: a third-party DLL the mod needs.

license.description: Required for a dependency: the licence it is shipped under.
